Fifty-eight paths forming the two-branch membership function f(x) = 1/(1 + a/(x-b)^2) for 1 <= x < 3 and f(x) = c ln x + d for 3 <= x <= 5, the partial large Cauchy distribution of the grading model. A display formula.
Thirty-nine paths forming the two-line parameter block a = 1.1086, b = 0.8942 / c = 0.3915, d = 0.3699 that fixes the function above. A displayed equation, not a figure.
Twenty-eight paths forming the information-entropy equation E_i = -(1/ln n) sum_j P_ij ln P_ij. A display formula.
Fifteen paths forming the entropy weight w_i = (1 - E_i) / (k - sum_i E_i). A display formula, and one that reuses i as both the free index and the sum index.
Fifteen paths forming W_i = V_i / sum V_i, the coefficient-of-variation weight. A display formula, printed immediately above Figure 3 and easy to mistake for its axis block.
Thirty-six paths forming the TOPSIS distance D_i+ = sqrt(sum_j w_j (Y_j+ - y_ij)^2). A display formula in a two-column equation row.
Thirty-three paths forming the companion distance D_i- = sqrt(sum_j w_j (Z_j- - z_ij)^2), printed beside the row above it.
Twenty paths forming NHHE_i = D_i- / (D_i+ + D_i-), the closeness score. A display formula, and the last thing printed before section 3.5 begins.

Forty-two paths forming INNI = (ln GNI_PC - ln a_min) / (ln a_max - ln a_min), the new economic indicator. A display formula; the prose under it then writes 'a_max is the maximum of CNI_PC', swapping in the wrong symbol for the series it just defined.

Fifty-two paths that are the outline strokes of two INLINE equations in the paragraph above - the Holt level and trend recursions - which the layout pass grouped into a box although they are set inside running prose. Not an exhibit, and not even a display equation.
Twenty-nine paths forming the covariance S_xy = sum (X_i - Xbar)(Y_i - Ybar) / (n - 1). A display formula.

Fifteen paths whose bbox is dominated by the PROSE line naming the three variance terms, with the display variances V, V_W and V_B falling just below it. The detector split one block of mathematics across this region and the next, so neither box is a formula on its own.
Eighteen paths likewise dominated by the prose line that introduces the mean square errors, with S_B = V_B/(a-1) and S_W^2 = V_W/(ab-a) below it. Half of one mathematics block, not an exhibit.
Thirty-two paths forming the F statistic F = [V_B/(a-1)] / [V_W/(ab-b)] = S_B^2 / S_W^2. A display formula, and its denominator reads ab - b where the mean-square equation above it reads ab - a.

This is the one exhibit whose caption and image are SPLIT BY A PAGE BREAK: the chart sits under the heading '8 Sensitivity Analysis' at the foot of p22 with no caption at all, and the caption opens p23 at y71.6, 18.7 pt under the running head, so the region row is anchored on the art's page while the caption is quoted from the next.

note: Twenty-five pages, 61 measured regions and 61 distinct page-plus-bbox keys - no duplicates anywhere in this paper, which is the opposite of the block's two-raster case. Of the 61, 25 are the page-foot WeChat stamp standing alone at the identical [448.3,721.7,583.1,789.1] block of exactly 693 paths and 0.019 area on EVERY page, with no fused stamp anywhere, so page furniture is perfectly regular here and the fused case is the exception rather than the rule. The remaining 36 regions hold 21 exhibits - Figures 1 to 16 and Tables 1 to 4 plus an unnumbered notation grid - and 15 display formulas, so the detector's region count is 2.9 times the exhibit count, its worst ratio yet, and the surplus is mathematics rather than fragments: 17 of the 21 exhibits are single bitmaps at 174 to 416 dpi with every label baked in, three were rescaled non-uniformly, and one table is a bitmap too, so almost nothing in this paper is recoverable from the text layer. Caption side obeys kind with no exception - figures below, tables above - and numbering is complete on both sides with punctuation split inside the paper: five figure captions and two table captions use the fullwidth CJK colon. Citation is the thinnest of the block: 14 pointers, 10 rows never cited, and all five cross-page pointers run forward. Families: 5 line, 4 flowchart-or-schematic, 2 other (Figure 9's radar and Figure 11's band-and-polyline chart, neither of which the vocabulary names), 1 composite-panel (Figure 3, six donuts), 1 map-or-plan-view, 1 node-link-network (the dendrogram), 1 bar, 1 scatter, plus 5 table-grids.
rules: Sixty-one measured regions on twenty-five pages account for twenty-one printed exhibits once every region is named: sixteen figures, four numbered tables and one unnumbered notation grid, with fifteen regions that are display mathematics and twenty-five that are the same page-foot stamp. The stamp is the block's cleanest furniture - exactly 693 paths at [448.3,721.7,583.1,789.1] and area 0.019 on every single page, never fused into an exhibit - so where #272 had two fused stamps this paper has none, and the [place.area_frac] of an excluded row is a constant here.

The paper prints twenty exhibit numbers and no gaps: 'Figure' 1 to 16 in reading order and 'Table' 1 to 4, with the notation grid on p4 carrying no number at all and landing in the table list as an unnumbered apparatus row whose only title is the heading '2.2 Notation' - [caption.numbering] 'none' and [caption_source] 'none' rather than promoting a heading into a caption.

Caption punctuation is split inside one paper: five figure captions and two table captions print the fullwidth CJK colon - Figures 1, 6, 7, 15 and 16, Tables 2 and 3 - while the other eleven figures and Tables 1 and 4 print the ASCII colon, so [caption.numbering] alternates between 'Figure N' and 'Figure N:' for reasons that are typographic and not structural.

Caption side is kind-driven with no exception in twenty-one rows: every figure caption prints BELOW its art - only Figures 6 and 7 clear the edge, by 0.18 and 0.66 pt, while the other eleven end 0.2 to 1.1 pt INSIDE the region bbox because the raster carries a blank foot, and the two p10 captions sit 25.0 pt inside on their 25 pt white margin - so [caption.position] 'below' rows routinely have their caption y inside the bbox, and all five table captions print ABOVE, their last line ending 1.9 pt clear of the top edge on Table 1, 0.1 pt clear on Tables 2 and 3, and 1.0 pt past it on Table 4.

Raster is the default in this paper: seventeen of the twenty-one exhibits are single bitmaps whose axis text, legends and node labels are all baked in, from 174 dpi for Figure 12 up to 416 dpi for Figure 10, and three of them were rescaled non-uniformly (408x362 dpi on Figure 4, 416x403 on Figure 10, 305x365 on Figure 16), so [geometry.family] here is read from crops and never from the text layer - the only text inside any figure bbox is the watermark run, never a chart word.

Figure 3 is the block's multi-part case: six donuts inside one raster, a central ring plus five satellites keyed to the five categories, so [geometry.panel_count] reads 6 and [geometry.panel_layout] '1+5' while the caption counts it as one exhibit - and no weight value prints on any wedge, so the figure titled 'Indicators weights' cannot be read for weights.

The figure families include two the closed vocabulary does not name: Figure 9 is a six-spoke radar and Figure 11 stacks four coloured bands under two polylines, so both rows are 'other' with an other_note rather than a wrong pick - while Figure 5, the paper's only dendrogram, is a node-link-network and Figure 4's choropleth is the only map-or-plan-view, so every [geometry.family] here comes off the drawing and is never inferred from a neighbouring row.

Legends are scarce and unreliable: 'below' on Figure 6 alone, 'above' on Figure 8 and Figure 11, 'inside' on Figures 4, 9, 10 and 16 where Figure 16's is three rotated series labels inside the plot, and 'none' on the other nine - with Figure 6's key printing 'Healthy' twice and Figure 4's grey fill absent from its key, so a missing [geometry.legend] entry is the commonest printed defect in this set.

Data labels appear on two charts only: Figure 10 prints a value beside almost every marker (the densest in the paper, and they collide in three places) and Figure 7 prints country callouts that merge into an unreadable band, so [geometry.data_labels] true coincides with the paper's two worst legibility failures.

Table rule styles split three ways from the drawings themselves: 'booktabs' on the p4 notation grid and nowhere else (3 black 1.44 pt strokes, x88.5 to 523.5, no vertical rule), 'boxed' on Tables 1, 2 and 3 (3 horizontals plus 8 or 6 verticals, Table 1's inside a 2048x297 px bitmap at 355 dpi), and 'no-rules' on Table 4, whose 64 drawing items are 40 cell fills plus 24 near-white 0.996 strokes - so [table.rule_style] must be read from the stroke colour, not from the path count.

Table 2 and Table 3 are one-row tables wearing a fifteen-year caption: two rows each (one header, one 'Score' body row) over a year-less seven-column frame, and the INNI pair the prose quotes (0.81296 to 0.83129) never appears in them - so [table.rows] 2 against a caption that promises a forecast is the block's clearest caption-content mismatch.

Citation is thin and forward-leaning: fourteen pointers reach eleven of the twenty-one exhibits, ten rows are never cited by number, and every pointer that crosses a page boundary crosses FORWARD - Figure 6, Figure 7, Figure 9, Figure 11 and Figure 14 are each named one page before the art prints, so [mention.lead_pages] reads +1 five times and 0 the other six times, the opposite sign to a block where figures are named after they appear.

Two exhibits are dated by their own text rather than by their neighbours: the notation grid is the only table in the paper without a number, and Figure 16 is the only exhibit whose caption is separated from its image by a page break - the chart prints under '8 Sensitivity Analysis' with no caption at the foot of p22 and the caption opens p23 - so [place.section_path] for that row is taken from the art's page while its caption comes from the next.

Fifteen of the sixty-one regions are display mathematics rather than exhibits, and the pass does not even find them all: p7 prints five display equations and boxes two, and on p16 one block of formulae is split across two regions that each carry a prose line, so [place.area_frac] on a small vector region is not by itself evidence of a formula - the cropped shape is.
